verdict.rationale: Fastmail's developer page documents first-party JMAP access through a session resource at api.fastmail.com, backed by open IETF RFCs. Hands-on community reports confirm IMAP use and SMTP access with app passwords. The standards-based export half of the story has no evidence; the pack covers import only. missing for 10: documented standards-based export (e.g. mbox/EML/vCard/iCal export), first-party documentation of IMAP and SMTP access.

support.subject: As a switcher, my mail stays reachable over open protocols and standard formats — IMAP/JMAP/SMTP access and standards-based export — so no client can lock me in

citations.quote: The JMAP session resource can be found at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session
No patents. No fees. Fully documented. JMAP is an open standard any organisation can implement
feel the subscription is a bit overpriced for IMAP-only use
Uses Fastmail SMTP for transactional emails with an app password that can only access SMTP.
